headline: AI answers are handing out coupon codes
dek: Google AI Overviews, AI Mode and ChatGPT have started showing promo codes right in the answer, sometimes with a copy button and an end date.
why: Any discount code you publish can now show up in an AI answer without a click to your site, which changes how holiday promos should be planned and tracked.
doThis: Use a unique, expiring code for each channel this holiday season so you can tell which ones AI tools pick up.
